clue.text: It goes on incessantly, even when idle

definitions.text: It goes on incessantly, even when idle

parts.words: It goes on incessantly, even when idle
parts.note: idle talk runs on without stopping, and an idle engine or idle teeth can rattle on too

explanation.surface: A riddle about something that never stops, even when doing nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Chatter is ceaseless idle talk, the kind of noise that keeps going with no purpose.

clue.text: Tricky ace held by a Babylonian

indicators.note: tricky suggests something awkward and twisted, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Babylonian keeps hold of a difficult ace in a card game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tricky' rearranges the letters of ACE HELD.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaldee is an old name for an inhabitant of Chaldea, the region of Babylonia.

clue.text: Leader of reform a Euro pean takes in a way

indicators.note: takes in means the Polish word-piece swallows the road abbreviation inside it

parts.note: a Pole is a European from Poland
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A European reformer travels along a road.
explanation.definitionFit: An apostle is the chief advocate who leads a new movement or reform.

clue.text: Solo, in fact, could be on this scale

indicators.note: could be signals that the letters might become something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A singer's solo might in practice be written on a particular musical scale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' rearranges the letters of SOLO IN FACT.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonic sol-fa is a system of notation naming the notes of the scale doh, ray, me and so on.

clue.text: Audience finds blood-red set back to front for operetta

indicators.note: an audience hears things, so the word sounded is what counts

parts.note: blood is GORE and red is RUDDY; set back to front, the two words swap order to give RUDDY GORE

explanation.surface: Theatregoers see blood-red scenery put in backwards at a light opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set back to front' swaps blood (GORE) and red (RUDDY), and 'Audience finds' says RUDDY GORE is heard: spelt RUDDIGORE, a Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruddigore is one of Gilbert and Sullivan's comic operas, a light musical stage work.

clue.text: Youngster with curly tail of some length once

parts.note: a cub is a young animal or a junior scout

indicators.note: curly means bent and twisted, so the letters of the word tail are rearranged

explanation.surface: A child with a curly pigtail.
explanation.definitionFit: Cubital relates to the cubit, an ancient measure of length from elbow to fingertip.

clue.text: Cover from which the arm of the law takes note

parts.note: police officers are the arm of the law, informally cops
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A police officer takes notes from a hiding place.
explanation.definitionFit: A copse is a small wood, which gives game and fugitives cover.

clue.text: Tom's pickled in brine or sulphur

indicators.note: pickled things are steeped and changed, so the letters are stirred into a new order

parts.note: the possessive keeps its S here as a letter of the mix

explanation.surface: Someone's cat is preserved in salt water or a sulphurous solution.
explanation.definitionFit: Brimstone is the old name for sulphur, the yellow element of hellfire.

clue.text: Follower having links with a tower

explanation.surface: A disciple connected to someone in a tall building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a tower' is something that tows, not a tall building.
explanation.definitionFit: A trailer is something that comes behind, and a vehicle hitched to the car towing it.

clue.text: Sheltered position of the Confederacy chief's a army?

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the commander of the Confederate army in the American Civil War
an army is one side in a war

explanation.surface: A question about where a Civil War general's troops were posted.
explanation.definitionFit: The lee side is the sheltered side, away from the wind.

clue.text: Bedecked French department a theologian toured

indicators.note: toured means went round, so the theologian's letters go around the department

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree
Orne is a department in Normandy

explanation.surface: A churchman travels round a region of France, dressed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Adorned and bedecked both mean decorated or ornamented.

clue.text: His work may reduce him to a shadow

definitions.text: His work may reduce him to a shadow

parts.words: His work may reduce him to a shadow
parts.note: to shadow someone is to follow them secretly, so this investigator's job turns him into a shadow

explanation.surface: Someone whose job wears him down to a thin wisp.
explanation.definitionFit: A hired investigator often tails a subject, which in slang is shadowing them.

clue.text: See 10
Islam stew

indicators.note: a stew mixes things up, so the letters are tossed into a new order

explanation.surface: A dish from the Islamic world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stew' rearranges ISLAM and also defines the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A salmi is a ragout of game birds, a kind of rich stew.

clue.text: Resinous substance note on the French motorway

parts.note: E is a musical note
le is French for the
the M1 is Britain's first major motorway, written MI

explanation.surface: Sticky stuff spotted on a road in France.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the main motorway north from London; crosswords read the 1 as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Elemi is a fragrant gum resin from tropical trees, used in varnishes.

clue.text: See 20
Straved into the nineteenth hole?

explanation.surface: A golfer wandered off to the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: The nineteenth hole is golfers' slang for the clubhouse bar, which lies beyond the eighteen holes of the course.
explanation.definitionFit: Going astray means leaving the planned route, and the bar lies outside the golf links.

clue.text: Destined to be about top, however foolish

indicators.note: to be about means to surround, so the fate word goes around the top word

parts.note: fated means destined
the head is the top of the body

explanation.surface: Fated to rise to the top, however silly one is.
explanation.definitionFit: Fatheaded means stupid, the head imagined as thick and dull.

clue.text: Conduct of a bad man in depression

indicators.note: in means the wicked man is placed inside the hollow

parts.note: a dent is a small hollow or depression
evil means bad
M is an abbreviation for male or man

explanation.surface: The behaviour of a wicked fellow who is feeling low.
explanation.definitionFit: Devilment is mischievous or reckless behaviour, a kind of naughty conduct.

clue.text: Forceful shuffling of cards, it would appear

indicators.note: shuffling mixes the pack, so the letters of these words are mixed

explanation.surface: A violent shuffle of the deck, so it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: Drastic measures are severe and vigorous, having a strong effect.

clue.text: Drapery made by a number with a pointed instrument

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five
a lance is a pointed weapon or surgical blade

explanation.surface: A curtain created by a figure wielding something sharp.
explanation.definitionFit: A valance is a short curtain or frill hung round a bed or window top.

clue.text: Age Edgar Allan reshaped with distinction

indicators.note: reshaped means formed anew, so the surname's letters are rearranged

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe was the American writer of tales of horror
CH is Companion of Honour, a British distinction

explanation.surface: An American writer gets a makeover and an honour.
explanation.definitionFit: An epoch is an era or long period of history.

clue.text: They're never what they seem

parts.note: tricks of the eye always mislead the viewer

explanation.surface: A warning about deceptive people.
explanation.definitionFit: Visual tricks deceive the eye, so the thing seen is not what is really there.

clue.text: Prepare to work like 8 S horse

definitions.text: Prepare to work like 8 S horse

parts.words: Prepare to work like 8 S horse
parts.note: read as putting tack and collar on a draught animal before it pulls; the 8 S is page debris for the word a

explanation.surface: Getting ready to labour like a workhorse.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed '8 S' is a scanning fault for 'a': the clue reads 'Prepare to work like a horse'.
explanation.definitionFit: To harness something is to put it to use, as tack readies a horse for pulling.

clue.text: Rebellious Titan brought to book

explanation.surface: A rebellious giant is made to answer for himself.
explanation.walkthrough: Atlas fought against the Olympian gods and was condemned to hold up the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlas is the Titan who rebelled against Zeus, and a bound collection of maps.

clue.text: One holding a watching brief, as it were

definitions.text: One holding a watching brief, as it were

parts.words: One holding a watching brief, as it were
parts.note: a lawyer with a watching brief observes a case; read plainly, the phrase means someone whose task is just to look on

explanation.surface: A lawyer instructed only to observe proceedings.
explanation.definitionFit: An onlooker's only job is to observe, the role of a member of an audience.

clue.text: See 3
Ducks under vampire at rest, albeit forbidden

indicators.note: under puts the zeros below the creature in this down answer
a vampire bat at rest hangs upside down, so the word is turned over

parts.note: a vampire is a kind of bat
a duck is a score of nothing, so two ducks are two Os

explanation.surface: Ducks beneath a sleeping vampire, though it isn't allowed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at rest' turns BAT to TAB, because bats hang upside down to sleep. A duck is a cricketer's score of zero.
explanation.definitionFit: Taboo means prohibited by custom or social rule.

clue.text: Does it cover a theatrical weapon?

definitions.text: Does it cover a theatrical weapon?

parts.words: Does it cover a theatrical weapon?
parts.note: a foil is a fencing sword, and a stage sword might be a metal-covered fake, so this metal wrap seems apt

explanation.surface: A question about the props department's swords.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin metal sheet is used to wrap things, and a foil is also a blunt fencing sword.

clue.text: Disastrous result of bed Alec made

indicators.note: made means put together, as a bed is made, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The mess that came of Alec making the bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A debacle is a complete fiasco or collapse.

clue.text: China's mark of distinction in London

explanation.surface: A sign of quality on porcelain found in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Chelsea porcelain was made in the London district of Chelsea in the 18th century, and its name is a mark of fine china.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of fine 18th-century English porcelain, and a fashionable district of the capital.

clue.text: Does old-fashioned scribbles

indicators.note: fashioned means shaped or made, so the letters are formed into a new word

explanation.surface: Someone does scribbles in an outdated style.
explanation.definitionFit: Doodles are aimless drawings or scribbles.
